summary: Default-off hard-valid semantic-contrast batch mixer + pairwise-margin objective implemented and wired into TwoTowerModel.training_loss; consumes the SLM-290 openui_hard_valid_v1 corpus. Bit-exact-when-disabled and enabled-smoke behavior verified by unit tests. A matched control/treatment fixture-scale run demonstrates the objective computes and logs the required fields end-to-end. No promotion-grade evidence was collected in this session.

objective.name: pairwise_margin_contrast
objective.selection_rationale: issue instructions named pairwise-margin/InfoNCE as the lower-risk, more standard choices given the session's time budget; margin was picked as the single preregistered objective to keep scope, testing, and bit-exactness verification tight
objective.representation: pooled context-encoder output (TwoTowerModel._pool_context over TwoTowerModel._encode_context) of the shared prompt (anchor), the gold OpenUI program text (positive), and the hard-valid mutated OpenUI program text (negative)
objective.formula: loss = mean(relu(margin + dist(anchor, positive) - dist(anchor, negative))), dist = 1 - cosine_similarity

corpus.note: positive-family (positive_control_identity) rows are excluded by the pair-level admitted filter; they are same-program controls where the 'negative' side also passed meaningful, not a usable hard-valid contrast

implementation.wiring_point: TwoTowerModel.training_loss, immediately before the final `return mask_loss`, gated by `if semantic_contrast_loss_weight > 0.0`; a new private helper `_semantic_contrast_loss_term` lazily loads and caches the corpus on the model instance and calls `compute_semantic_contrast_step`
implementation.logged_via: TwoTowerModel.last_training_metrics (JSONL step rows in train_loop.py) plus the full per-pair record available from SemanticContrastStepResult.to_dict()

bit_exactness_evidence.claim: semantic_contrast_loss_weight == 0.0 (the dataclass default) is bit-exact and RNG-identical with the prior training_loss code path
bit_exactness_evidence.method: identical seed construction, state_dict equality check post-construction, RNG-state-controlled backward() loss-tensor equality check (mirrors the repo's existing binder_arity_loss_weight-style optional-loss pattern), and a direct assertion that the corpus cache/step-counter are never touched when disabled

enabled_evidence.claim: fixture/smoke-scale only -- NOT the AP-010 promotion claim
unit_tests: tests/test_models/test_semantic_contrast_loss.py (16 tests; pure loss/sampling/loader logic, no TwoTowerModel construction)
enabled_evidence.harness_smoke: docs/design/iter-slm292-semantic-contrast-smoke-20260725.{json,md} (python -m scripts.run_slm292_semantic_contrast_smoke): matched control (weight=0.0) vs treatment (weight=1.0) TwoTowerModel arms, identical seed/architecture/records/steps; 15 steps each, d_model=32, 2 training records; treatment arm's per-step loss/margin/mutation-sampling/distance fields all logged and finite; per-mutation-family (content/binding/contract) aggregate distances reported
enabled_evidence.run_time: ~5s total (well under the repo's 3-minute MAX_RUN_MINUTES hard run cap)

acceptance_bar_status.meaning_v2_plus_0_05_absolute_or_binder_: NOT MEASURED (would require full training corpus + frozen held-out suite eval with evaluate_model --ship-gates)
acceptance_bar_status.replicate_on_ge_3_seeds: NOT MEASURED (this session ran 1 seed at fixture scale only)

scope_deliberately_excluded: Full >=3-seed promotion campaign on the real training corpus + frozen held-out suites

Raw/constrained/repaired decode-outcome comparisons (a single constrained TwoTowerModel.generate call takes >60s on even a toy architecture and would blow MAX_RUN_MINUTES for a fixture smoke; deferred to scripts.evaluate_model at proper scale)
InfoNCE and semantic-regret objective variants (only pairwise-margin implemented, per the issue's 'pick ONE' instruction)
recommended_follow_up: New Linear issue (or SLM-292 continuation) to run the preregistered >=3-seed promotion campaign: real SFT training corpus for the token-CE loss, SLM-290 openui_hard_valid_v1 (train split) for the contrast objective, frozen held-out/adversarial/rico_held suites for meaning-v2 and binder/reference F1, evaluate_model --ship-gates for the syntax/contract validity regression check, paired bootstrap CI across seeds excluding zero before any promotion claim.

If promoted, extend the SLM-290 corpus's topology/binding_introduce_incompatible_symbol/contract_unresolve mutation families (currently small/absent in the admitted pairs) so the contrast objective is not only trained on content/binding/contract archetype mismatches.
